record.summary: The production custodian authorizes the observer_fit target bundle for diagnostics and fitted-observer development. The scan decodes only MLP IDs and layer means, records names_scores_board_joins=0 and raw_full_dataset_access=0 per row, and leaves observer_selection sealed. This supersedes the earlier public-name-ledger blocker for finding lawful analogs; it does not reveal exact board identities.
